name: @muhaven/checkout-pay
description: Hosted checkout buyer page for MuHaven (pay.muhaven.app). Renders the issuer label + decrypted amount, runs the ZeroDev passkey ceremony, and walks the buyer through fund → wrap → buy.

scripts.build: vite build && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html && node scripts/deploy-to-checkout-web.mjs
scripts.build:stage: vite build --mode stage && cp dist/index.html dist/404.html && MUHAVEN_CHECKOUT_WEB_TARGET_DIR=../../../muhaven-checkout-web-stage node scripts/deploy-to-checkout-web.mjs
